project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-11. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 0 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment completed 2026-08-11: 7 of 8 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; unresolved entries were individually checked and retained as unknown.

touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Gumley qualifies as a local detour through Gumley motte castle and Gumley medieval settlement remains and field systems, 620m south east of the Church of St Helen. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Gumley: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Gumley offers Gumley motte castle, Gumley medieval settlement remains and field systems, 620m south east of the Church of St Helen, CHURCH OF ST HELEN within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Gumley motte castle
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with Gumley motte castle and Gumley medieval settlement remains and field systems, 620m south east of the Church of St Helen, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.

dontMiss: Gumley medieval settlement remains and field systems, 620m south east of the Church of St Helen
